desc: Ideation: identify marginal-cost arithmetic progressions P_i, 3P_i, 5P_i, ... and the threshold counting/summing formulas.

Implement direct threshold (water-level) binary search: find smallest X where total cost of units with marginal <= X exceeds M; then buy all units with marginal < X and floor((M - cost_below)/X) units at marginal X (capped at available units at cost X).
Validate algorithm against both samples (PASSED), plus edge cases: N=1, M=1, all P_i equal, optimal threshold exactly at a marginal cost, and large M.
Write the final Python program reading stdin and printing the answer to stdout, ensuring integer-safe arithmetic for values up to 1e18 and capping intermediate sums at M+1 for speed.
